title: Conversation map — PM/Eng compact: API • Console • Dedicated • Private
content:
Meeting purpose: quick, tactical sync to align on two near-term risks and 3 action items I want help unblocking. Keep this tight (25 min) — triage + owners + deadlines.

Timebox: 25 minutes
Attendees (expected): Evelyn (PM), Luca (Eng lead) — if Luca busy, Diego attends

Topline context (one-liners):
- Hosted API: model-pin rollout for v2.1 caused small % of traffic routed to low‑capacity Dedicated nodes overnight (symptom: 4–8% error spike, 200ms p95 bump). Need immediate mitigation + postmortem scope.
- Console: customers and internal SREs report the new per-route token cost breakdown is missing for multi-model routes — affects billing transparency and alerts.
- Dedicated: autoscaler mis-estimates queue depth when burst windows align with nightly cache flushes — observed latency spikes at 03:30 UTC for two customers.
- Private: small memory growth in KV cache during long-running streams on on-prem deploy (MVP customer). Low severity now but could escalate.

Agenda (ordered):
1) Fast triage: Hosted model-pin routing issue (8 min)
   - quick root hypothesis: routing/matching logic treats pinned variants as incompatible with spillover policy -> falls back to soft-routing into dedicated tier instead of hosted variant.
   - immediate ask: set temporary policy to prefer hosted variant strictly for host-originated requests (hotfix config) — Luca to confirm feasibility.
   - metric to watch: error-rate (5xx) and p95 latency for pinned routes over next 6 hours.
2) Console telemetry gap (6 min)
   - ask: confirm owners for console backend + billing ingestion pipeline to add per-route multi-model breakdown to the analytics table.
   - tradeoff: computing breakdown at ingest time vs. query-time join (cost vs latency). Prefer ingest-time for SLA.
   - proposed quick win: add a flag to dashboard that surfaces "estimated cost delta" until ingestion is fixed.
3) Dedicated autoscale pattern + Private KV leak (6 min)
   - autoscale: share recent flamegraph + queue histograms. Proposal: introduce short-term guardrail that pins buffer to 2x expected baseline during nightly cache flush windows.
   - KV leak: ask for heap-dump correlator run on the affected on-prem instance; not blocking, but schedule with Solutions Eng.
4) Decisions & action review (5 min)

Key questions I want answered in the meeting: (quick bullets for Luca)
- Can we flip the model-pin routing policy to prefer hosted variant within one deployment window? (yes/no + risk level)
- Which console backend owner will own the ingestion change? (name + ETA)
- Is the dedicated autoscale guardrail implementable as a config change vs code change? (config preferred)

Proposed action items (concrete):
- Evelyn: create postmortem stub and collect logs for pinned routes (by EOD today) [OPEN]
- Luca: validate hotfix feasibility (policy flip) and respond in Slack with rollout plan (by 2024-11-06) [OWNER: Luca]
- Diego: add temporary dashboard flag ("estimated cost delta") in Console to unblock support (by 2024-11-08) [OWNER: Diego]
- Maya: coordinate heap dump + correlator with customer on-prem (contact: infra-team@example.com) (by 2024-11-12) [OWNER: Maya]
- Eng: smoke test autoscale guardrail on staging during nightly flush simulation (target window: next staging run) [OWNER: Luca/infra]

Parking lot / follow-ups (no need to discuss unless time):
- Longer-term: revisit spillover policy semantics across Dedicated vs Hosted variants (tie to rollout playbook).
- Document runbooks for per-route cost alerts — connect with Billing to avoid false positives.
- Evaluate whether KV cache should expose streaming TTL metrics for on-prem customers.

Notes-to-self (quick):
- Bring up risk of rolling model-pin rollback causing noise in A/B telemetry; ask for staged rollout with canary and circuit breaker thresholds.
- If Luca can't attend, ask Diego to own items 2+3 for the quick wins.

Useful logs/queries to paste in meeting (short snippets):
- pinned-route error query: SELECT route_id, count(5xx), p95(latency) FROM request_metrics WHERE route IN ("/v2/text/pinned") AND ts > (now()-6h) GROUP BY route_id
- autoscale queue histogram: q_histogram(bucket, count) last_24h filter tag:nightly-flush

Tone / ask for the meeting: short, solution oriented, clear owners. Primary decision: host-variant preference hotfix vs rollback. Secondary: who owns console ingestion fix.

End-of-doc checklist (what I will do after meeting):
- Move postmortem stub to Confluence and link JIRA-INF-4821
- Confirm slash channel: #pm-hosted-api (create if missing) and post interim metrics
- Track action items in a tiny project board (Evelyn -> create board)

Last-minute reminder: keep the discussion to 25 minutes. If we need to deep-dive on autoscale, schedule a follow-up 45-min technical session with infra + SRE.

-- E.P.
summary: Compact conversation map for a PM/Eng sync focusing on routing/model-pin, console telemetry, dedicated autoscale, and private KV cache. Clear asks, owners, and timebox.
